subject: Re: Vendor portal kick-off & mandatory DPA/SOC2 materials
messages:
From: Alice Ho <alice.ho@thermods.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@thermods.com
Date: Tue, 9 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: mandatory privacy/security items

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick details during yesterday's intake call. Procurement (cc'd) needs the vendor evidence package to kick off PO creation. At a minimum we need the following items back to procurement@thermods.com and uploaded to our vendor portal by Friday:

- Signed DPA (or PDF draft we'll countersign)
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (or secure link + summary of scope and date)
- Full subprocessor inventory (CSV or spreadsheet with vendor, function, country)
- W-9 / vendor tax form for US vendors

Can you confirm you can bind these to the portal and whether Redwood can accept our standard PO language (we have two clauses flagged for legal review)? I've attached our onboarding checklist for reference.

Attachment: thermods_proc_req.pdf (procurement checklist, 2 pages)

If there's any required evidence that's not public (e.g., SOC 2 redaction requests), let us know and procurement will open an NDA/secure-file path.

Best,
Alice
Alice Ho
Senior Procurement Manager
Thermo Dynamics

From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
To: Alice Ho <alice.ho@thermods.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 9 Apr 2029 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: mandatory privacy/security items

Hi Alice — thanks for the checklist. We can get everything into your portal and share the secure SOC 2 link. Short answers up front:

- DPA: attaching Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf (draft) — happy to sign or countersign. If you need edits, please mark and return.
- SOC 2: public link attached (internal: Drive). Full report available via secure link; pointer included below.
- Subprocessors: attached CSV (subprocessor_inventory_20290409.csv) with function and hosting region.
- W-9: attached (we route W-9s via Finance; see related link).

DocuSign: we prefer to e-sign the DPA. If ThermoDS needs a countersigned PDF first, we can produce it within 24 hours.

I also noted you said two PO clauses are flagged — can you paste them inline or attach the redlines? Ben (Legal) and Laura (Finance/Procurement ops) are cc'd to help triage.

Next steps proposal:
1) We upload documents to your vendor portal today (we'll need the portal vendor ID).
2) Procurement confirms PO net terms and any SLA exceptions.
3) Sign DPA via DocuSign (link below) and complete W-9 exchange so PO can be created.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf; subprocessor_inventory_20290409.csv
Links: https://drive.redwood-internal.com/secure/soc2/Redwood_SOC2_2028_report.pdf

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Head of Vendor Programs
Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding: mandatory privacy/security items

Forwarding Alice's checklist and Tessa's attachments for legal + procurement review. Ben's notes inline below.

On Tue, Apr 9, 2029 at 11:37 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Alice — thanks for the checklist. We can get everything into your portal and share the secure SOC 2 link...

--- Ben's quick triage ---
- DPA: Redwood_DPA_v3 has our minimal liability carveouts and a standard data-scope definition. Procurement's flagged clauses: (1) long-tail indemnity; (2) ambiguous data residency language.
- Action: Laura, please confirm whether Finance needs PO language changed for net-30 vs net-45 — Thermo's procurement mailbox often requests net-45 for new vendors. If we accept net-45, accounting will mark the invoice flow accordingly.
- If Thermo insists on the indemnity language, escalate to Aditya (CC'd) to authorize limited exceptions.

Proposed timeline: Legal review by end of day Wed (10th). If redlines are minimal, we can e-sign the DPA and upload signed copy to Thermo's portal by Thu morning.

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
